text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking along the 
riverbank――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whew……! Once I take a breather, it's time 
for one more run!
choice_data_list: You're really dedicated to your training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah. You're a trainer at the academy, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored by your praise! Though I still 
have a long, long way to go...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I want to catch up to the person I 
admire, I've got to work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen-san... That's Maruzensky-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She's so fast, stylish, and cool, amazing 
at driving, and so very kind on top of it 
all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The absolute pinnacle of a bold and 
beautiful Yamato Nadeshiko! She is my 
ultimate idol!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In any case—Maruzen-san is just so, sooo 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... If only I could become such a 
wonderful Umamusume someday too...
choice_data_list: Staying true to yourself is important too.
I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hau, that's true...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard I try... I could never 
become like Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In every era, fleeting feelings are blown 
about like snowdrifts between dream and 
reality...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still, standing on that very same stage is 
something I believe... can surely come 
true.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Staying true to myself, working steadily 
without overdoing it, I want to bud and 
bloom.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I feel courage welling up inside me 
now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right, break's over. I'm going for 
another run!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
. Hearing you say that fills me with 
courage!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still, Maruzen-san feels so far out of 
reach. Catching up to her won't be easy...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
However, I truly believe that we will be 
able to stand upon the very same stage 
together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What is now just a tiny bud puts in 
diligent effort day after day...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Just like cherry blossoms blooming in 
spring, I promise to make these feelings 
blossom one day!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right, break's over. I'm going for 
another run!
